rows.en: Infiltrate Mining Planet
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Reach the destination
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Time limit exceeded
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Defeat all Bat-Shu units
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: The investigation team pursuing Poseidal seems to have picked up the E2's trail.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: The site is the mining planet <pic(0)><cs(3)>Palata Star<ce()>, an abandoned planet once owned by Poseidal.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: <mk(37.5,-37.5,1,1,100)><ar(0,1,1,150)>A suspicious transport shuttle was seen entering. It seems to be in contact with outside.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: If they're stopping somewhere like this, they may be dealing with another faction...
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: The investigation team infiltrated the planet ahead of us, and we've lost contact since.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: In light of this, we will now carry out a mission to infiltrate <mk(-50,50,1,0,150)><ar(0,1,0,150)>Palata Star.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: Make recovering the E2 your top priority, and adapt to the situation as you go.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: I knew there were radical civilians in the colonies who took an <cs(1)>anti-UCE<ce()> stance.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: But I never imagined they'd get mixed up in this E2 affair...
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: No doubt the trigger was the UCE starting full-scale preparations to advance into space.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: If Earth-colony relations get any worse, innocent civilians will be caught up in it.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: I'd say it was fortunate we were able to stop them this time.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: My call: I'd rather not report this upstairs. Getting the E2 back will settle it all.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: The remaining E2s are the two held by Giganos and White Fang.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: From here on, we'll have to deal with things swiftly... Keep that in mind.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: You went down at a time this critical!? Pull yourself together!
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?
